marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF809D1 Cordless Compact Impact Driver Kit features a compact and lightweight design, powered by a 20 V MAX Atomic Lithium-Ion battery with 2 Ah capacity. It includes a 1/4 in. hex quick-release chuck and offers up to 1700 in-lb torque, making it suitable for a variety of tasks. The kit also includes a fast charger and an integrated belt hook for added convenience.
